source_title: Will Alan Shearer's Premier League goalscoring record ever be broken? - BBC
source_excerpt:
In this week's edition of The Football Interview, Kelly Somers speaks to former Premier League striker and BBC Sport pundit Alan Shearer.
They speak about his Premier League goalscoring record, leaving his hometown of Newcastle for Southampton as a teenager and winning the Premier League with Blackburn Rovers.
Shearer also chats about his life as a football fan and the feeling when the Magpies won the League Cup in 2025, their first trophy in his lifetime.
You can listen to the full episode above or on BBC Sounds.
